searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: LinkedIn content-search queries. Boolean syntax works, e.g. "hiring" AND "Backend Developer".

maxPosts.title: Max posts per query
maxPosts.description: Stops scrolling once this many posts are collected for a query.

liAtCookie.description: Optional. Overrides the LINKEDIN_LI_AT environment variable. Copy it from your browser's linkedin.com cookies.
